decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey rear extension to the ground floor flat that has a maximum depth of 3.05m from the rear of the original rear wall of the building, as shown on drawing number 2656 01 Rev. C, received 28 March 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, with the rear extension to have a depth of no more than 3.05m from the rear wall of the existing ground floor to the external face of the rear wall of the extension, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and new side window to house
